notes.title: FREE TO PLAY Coming Soon!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Welcome To The Dreamscape will become free to play coming March 29*!  I'm excited for more people to have the opportunity to play the game!  I'd like to thank you all for you continued support!  It means the world as I continue to try to develop the highest quality games possible!

- Conner Rush of FYRE Games

*While this it the expected date, it is still subject to change if necessary.

notes.title: Welcome To The Dreamscape Update V1.1.3!
notes.content:
Just a quick update to improve your experience with Welcome To The Dreasmcape!



Features in V1.1.3:

     - There are now 3 new achievements to unlock to add some new challenges to the game!



Thank you for all of your input!  I look forward to implementing further updates!

notes.title: Welcome To The Dreamscape Update V1.1.2!
notes.content:
Just a few minor fixes.  Here's what's going on!



Features in V1.1.2:

     - Fixed issue where pausing in Chapter 3 caused the game to exit to the main menu.

     - Fixed Subtitle that was not rendering properly in Chapter 2



Thank you for all of your support and I hope to hear from more of you in the future!  Thank you!

notes.title: Welcome To The Dreamscape Update V1.1.1!
notes.content:
Just a few bug fixes have been made to Welcome To The Dreamscape! Here's what's been done.



Features in V1.1.1:

     - Fixed issues with certain achievements not registering properly.

     - Fixed a few issues with UI not rendering properly.



As always, if you run into any issues, be sure to contact me!  I'm always looking to make this game as good as it can be!  Thank you, and have a great day!

notes.title: Welcome To The Dreamscape V1.1 is Live!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that the first update for Welcome To The Dreamscape has gone live, and a lot of great stuff was done to improve your experience!



Features in V1.1:

     - Welcome To The Dreamscape now support Steam Achievements!  There are now a total of 9 achievements.

     - In response to suggestions from the public, I've sought to make the platforming sections less of a struggle.  Platforms have received a 75% increase in width to make these sections less of a hassle.

     - Issues involving the UI distorting when playing the game at ratios other than 16:9 have been fixed!

     - The enemy hit-boxes have been adjusted to prevent bullets from not registering when at very close range.



I'd like to thank all of you for helping me improve upon this game to make it the best it can be!  Please feel free to contact me if you find anymore issues, and I'll do my best to resolve them.  Thank you, and have a great day!

- Conner Rush of FYRE Games

notes.title: Release Date Pushed Back 1 Day
notes.content:
I would like to apologize in regards to our original set release date of June 27.  Due to particular review processes in Steam, Welcome To The Dreamscape will not be released until June 28 despite hat the pre-release trailer says.  We thank you for your patience and we hope that you enjoy the game when it is released.  Thank You!

- Conner Rush of FYRE Games
